title: Scalar and Vector Triple Products
formulas: Scalar triple product $[\vec{a}\ \vec{b}\ \vec{c}] = \vec{a}\cdot(\vec{b}\times\vec{c})$ is the volume of the parallelepiped; it is zero for coplanar vectors.
keyPoints: Coplanarity test in one line: the volume [a b c] is 0 — use it instead of solving three planes for a common point.
summary: Scalar and Vector Triple Products covers essential principles and applications.
